# jamfplatform_pro_app_installers (Data Source)

Returns every App Installer deployment for the tenant in expanded form, including the resolved app, site, category, and smart-group references and per-deployment computer status counts. Use the optional `name_substring` to narrow the result; matching is case-insensitive and applied after the full list is fetched.

**Required Jamf privileges**

The Jamf Platform API integration used by the provider must be granted the following privileges:

| Jamf Pro privilege | Scoped name |
|---|---|
| Read Mac Applications | `read:pro:mac-applications` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every App Installer deployment (expanded form with resolved app/site/
# category/smart-group references and per-deployment computer status counts).
data "jamfplatform_pro_app_installers" "all" {}

# Narrow the list to deployments whose name contains a substring.
data "jamfplatform_pro_app_installers" "editor" {
  name_substring = "Editor"
}

output "editor_deployment_ids" {
  value = [for d in data.jamfplatform_pro_app_installers.editor.deployments : d.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_substring` (String) Optional case-insensitive substring matched against each deployment's name. When omitted, all deployments are returned.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `deployments` (Attributes List) App Installer deployments, optionally narrowed by `name_substring`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployments))
- `id` (String) Internal identifier for this data source read.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--deployments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployments`

Read-Only:

- `app` (Attributes) Resolved catalog app reference. Null when the deployment has no app. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployments--app))
- `category` (Attributes) Resolved category reference. Null when no category is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployments--category))
- `computer_statuses` (Attributes) Per-deployment computer status counts. Null when the server does not report them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployments--computer_statuses))
- `deployment_type` (String) Delivery method.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the deployment is enabled.
- `id` (String) Deployment ID.
- `name` (String) Deployment display name.
- `site` (Attributes) Resolved site reference. Null when no site is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployments--site))
- `smart_group` (Attributes) Resolved smart computer group reference. Null when no smart group is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployments--smart_group))
- `update_behavior` (String) Update behavior.

<a id="nestedatt--deployments--app"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployments.app`

Read-Only:

- `bundle_id` (String) Primary bundle identifier.
- `deployed_version` (String) Currently deployed version.
- `icon_url` (String) App icon URL.
- `id` (String) Catalog title ID.
- `latest_version` (String) Latest catalog version.
- `media_source_type` (String) Media source type (e.g. JAMF_SERVER).
- `selected_version` (String) Selected version. Empty under AUTOMATIC.
- `title_available_in_ais` (Boolean) Whether the title is available in the App Installers catalog.
- `version_removed` (Boolean) Whether the selected version has been removed.


<a id="nestedatt--deployments--category"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployments.category`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Reference ID.
- `name` (String) Reference display name.


<a id="nestedatt--deployments--computer_statuses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployments.computer_statuses`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Number) Computers where the app is available.
- `failed` (Number) Computers where the install failed.
- `in_progress` (Number) Computers where the install is in progress.
- `installed` (Number) Computers where the app is installed.
- `unqualified` (Number) Computers that do not qualify for the deployment.


<a id="nestedatt--deployments--site"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployments.site`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Reference ID.
- `name` (String) Reference display name.


<a id="nestedatt--deployments--smart_group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployments.smart_group`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Reference ID.
- `name` (String) Reference display name.
